title: Resident Handbook — Monthly Pet Fees on the Coming Month's Independent Living Statement
content:
Registered pets are billed on the coming month's statement of an Independent Living Residency Agreement at the monthly pet fee per pet, without proration.

## How many pets

The number of pets is the quantity on the latest pet monthly fee charge on the residency ledger (latest by service date):

- a household with **two or more** registered pets adds the monthly pet fee once for each pet;
- a household with **one** registered pet adds the monthly pet fee once;
- a household with **no pet monthly fee charge** adds nothing for pets.

## Monthly pet fee by apartment type

| Apartment type | Monthly pet fee per pet | Added for one pet | Added for two pets |
|---|---|---|---|
| Independent Living Studio | 35.00 | 35.00 | — (one pet permitted) |
| Independent Living One-Bedroom | 35.00 | 35.00 | — (one pet permitted) |
| Independent Living One-Bedroom Deluxe | 40.00 | 40.00 | 80.00 |
| Independent Living Two-Bedroom | 40.00 | 40.00 | 80.00 |
| Independent Living Two-Bedroom Deluxe | 45.00 | 45.00 | 90.00 |
| Independent Living Cottage Home | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |

## Hypothetical household

A Two-Bedroom Deluxe household whose latest pet monthly fee charge carries a quantity of 2 adds 45.00 for each pet, 90.00, to the coming month's statement; the pet amount is a whole month's fee per pet, never prorated.
